statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes submitted are I34.0 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The claim was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
The diagnosis codes I34.0 and R42 support this medically necessary diagnostic procedure
